title: CBOE uses CSV export endpoint not PDF
rationale: CBOE CDN moved from /resources/regulation/fee_schedules/ to date-stamped paths that change on every update. Use stable HTML landing page CSV export instead: /us/options/membership/fee_schedule/<slug>/?csv=true&feedate=YYYY-MM-DD. Slugs: edgx=edgx, bzx=bzx, c2=ctwo, cboe=cone. Returns Code,Description,Fee in dollars per contract.

name: CBOE landing page URLs
description: EDGX: cboe.com/us/options/membership/fee_schedule/edgx/ | BZX: .../bzx/ | C2: .../ctwo/ | CBOE C1: .../cone/ | Append ?csv=true&feedate=YYYY-MM-DD for CSV export

content: CBOE CSV fee values are dollars per contract. Negative=fee charged, Positive=rebate paid. 72 codes total. AIM auction codes start with B, SAM solicitation codes start with S, Complex/MLEG codes start with Z. Customer electronic: CA NC PC. Professional Customer: NP PP.

Never hardcode CBOE PDF URLs. They include the effective date in the filename (e.g. Cboe-EDGX-Options-Fee-Schedule-Updates-Effective-March-2-2026.pdf) and change with every fee update. The CSV endpoint and landing page URLs are stable.

description: MIAX URLs 404: domain migrated from miaxoptions.com to miaxglobal.com with dated filenames. NYSE ARCA filename case changed (NYSE_Arca_Options not NYSE_ARCA_Options). BOX domain changed to boxexchange.com. MEMX page restructured.
resolution: Updated all 7 URLs in config/exchanges.yaml. MEMX: MemxFetcher now scrapes landing page for CSV link (preferred) or PDF link dynamically.

content: Nasdaq fee schedule URLs use the pattern <exchange>-options-7 (e.g. nasdaq-options-7), NOT <exchange>-options-fees. The -fees suffix returns 404.

CBOE fee schedule HTML (not a JS SPA) has a dedicated id=fee-schedule-footnotes ordered list. Each <li> has data-feecodes='CA,PC,...' listing exactly which fee codes that footnote applies to — authoritative mapping, no inference needed.

MIAX moved domain to miaxglobal.com. Each exchange has its own stable landing page: miax-options/fees, pearl-options/fees, emerald-options/fees, sapphire-options/fees. PDFs are date-stamped filenames — fetcher must discover them from the landing page at runtime.
BOX moved to boxexchange.com. Fee schedule landing page is at /regulatory/fees/ (not /trading/fee-schedule/ or /assets/). PDF link is auto-discovered from that page.
NYSE ARCA PDF filename uses 'Arca' not 'ARCA' capitalization: NYSE_Arca_Options_Fee_Schedule.pdf. NYSE AMEX still at NYSE_American_Options_Fee_Schedule.pdf.

description: Nasdaq BX, Gemini, Mercury at listingcenter.nasdaq.com return HTTP 200 with only page chrome (14KB) — no fee data in static HTML
resolution: These 3 exchanges require JS rendering (Playwright) or session cookies to access fee tables. NOM, PHLX, ISE return full content (500KB+) without auth.
